findings.location: prepareInterrupted lines835-844; preproofReview validation lines889-892 and lifecycle verify lines910-921
findings.problem: Renewed pre-proof review calls checkActionRecoveryContext, which has no preference-head or original read-marker block-hash validation. Its subsequent submission only binds local provenance/predecessor, not these saved semantic contexts. Unlike existing saved-byte and replacement recovery, a read-marker can be re-proved against a different canonical block at the same throughBlock after reorg. The head or marker can also change after renewed review before persistence/broadcast.
findings.required: Reuse the existing exact originalPreferenceHead/expectedRevision/originalMarker checks for renewed preparation and late renewed submission. Refuse changed head/hash rather than silently rebasing. Retain original generic action-specific late context checks too. Add focused changed-marker and late-change regressions in existing application tests.
findings.evidence: Direct source path comparison to savedContextMatches/checkSavedResumeContext/checkReplacementReview; not yet executed adversarial regression.

findings.location: prepareBokPost record creation lines800-802; submitPrepared lines889-892
findings.problem: prepareBokPost spreads the prior confirmed authorization into a new id/operation, retaining preproofReview from an authorization that previously renewed after a proof interruption. That review contains the predecessor BEFORE authorization. Current journal now contains the confirmed authorization, so new post submit deterministically rejects its predecessor equality. The same stale-attempt leak can affect another post after a renewed reverted post.
findings.required: When constructing the explicitly new Bok post operation, remove prior-attempt preproof/preproofReview authority while preserving funded draft, authorization and canonical predecessor bindings. Add interrupted authorization -> explicit renewed review -> confirmation -> normal Bok post regression.
findings.evidence: Direct source dataflow; no live or model operation. Ordinary uninterrupted authorization tests do not exercise inherited preproofReview.
